summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release (Exhibit 99.1) for the period ended September 30, 2026. Results showed ARR of $528.5 million (up 20% year-over-year), revenue of $149.0 million (up 18%), GAAP net income of $26.7 million, non-GAAP net income of $45.6 million, adjusted EBITDA of $53.6 million (36.0% margin), and trailing-twelve-month free cash flow of $166.0 million (30.9% margin). Management raised the 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook. Separately noted is a previously announced plan to redomicile as a U.S. parent company, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The filing is an ordinary quarterly results release with no transaction terms.
